description:
The webhook handler for `checkout.session.completed` currently marks `checkout_sessions.status = 'complete'` before calling `insertOrUpdateSubscription()`, and the two writes are not in the same DB transaction. If the subscription insert fails after the status update commits, the user has paid but gets no subscription and nothing detects this. Wrap both writes in a single transaction so either both succeed or both roll back.

Root cause (Finding 6 of research/lpbs-payment-guardrails-and-reconciliation-plan): webhook updates checkout_sessions and subscriptions in separate transactions; a silent partial-failure mode the current idempotency primitives do not catch.
name: lpbs-checkout-webhook-atomicity
title: Wrap checkout_sessions status update and subscription insert in a single transaction
